historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for the multi-purpose building at Storyland, the zoo's children's area, by J. Francis Ward.
The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for the zoo's African Scene, whose first drawings by J. Francis Ward it had approved on March 1, 1965.
